H1_intraday_momentum.description: intraday momentum: move-so-far (from the prior close or the open) predicts the rest of the session; executable windows only

execution_notes: intraday, flat by 15:50: executable with the current position lifecycle and allowlist (after validation and prospective promotion)
fill model: marketable LIMIT (10 bps) at the next bar open, non-fill if it opens through the limit; protective stop on every position; runtime cost model charged once per leg

policy_tier.note: 1 position, <= 25% of equity, whole shares, allowlisted symbols, same fill model

fail_reasons: no edge vs passive benchmark (Sharpe-diff SPA p=1.00, alpha t=-1.51)
